dataset: Wu et al. 2021 local six-patient Visium cohort, Zenodo 4739739
split_rule: Fixed paired split: 1142243F calibration /1160920F evaluation (independent lab TNBC); CID4465 calibration /CID44971 evaluation (local TNBC); CID4535 calibration /CID4290 evaluation (local ER). Declared before gene expression values or outcomes.
panel: S2-50 exact original order, all 50 genes
secondary_panel: S2-280 overlap documented; optional evaluation omitted prospectively

models.M0: Frozen C4 primary D1 three-seed image ensemble in original C0 normalized log-count units
models.M1: C5/C7 spatial interpolation: inverse-distance power2 with up to16 nearest observed anchors V1, unweighted mean16 V2
models.M2: C8 T1 patient-weighted per-gene z-score; destination fit on calibration patients only; interpolate, then inverse-map to common C0 normalized log-count units
models.M3: Exactly 0.2 calibrated image +0.8 M2; source moments from original NCBI783/NCBI785, destination from calibration patients; no fit of weights

harmonization_identifiability: Affine transformation commutes with normalized linear interpolation. M1 and M2 must be identical within numerical tolerance in common units; neither scale-dependent native errors nor roundoff can establish harmonization benefit/stability. C8A benefit concerned image-based cross-platform calibration. Its benefit cannot be isolated by M2-M1 here. This is recorded before outcomes.
sampling_definition: Exact C7/policy.py label-free nested permutation/FPS. Round floor(N*budget+.5), V2 denominator all eligible tissue locations before forbidden-region exclusion.

regimes.V2: Three compact forbidden40% regions centered at25/50/75% of PC1 spatial rank, exact frozen C7 geometry; anchors outside; score fixed forbidden locations. All other unobserved values excluded too.

preprocessing.counts: Published filtered count matrices, provided in-tissue flag only; finite nonnegative integer counts; log1p and unchanged C0 training mean/SD; no external library-size, depth or area normalization
preprocessing.coordinates: Barcode-joined pixel centers; fullres micrometers/pixel from least-squares lattice mapping and documented100um pitch; spot-diameter metadata is recorded but not used for scale because inconsistent with source lattice
preprocessing.images: Supplied unannotated Space Ranger tissue_hires_image.png, source-scaled coordinates, 112um square using lattice-calibrated mpp, nearest-integer width/top-left, LANCZOS to224 RGB; exact C0 ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1 transform and frozen weights.
preprocessing.target_units: Common C0 standardized log1p count units for every method; per-gene linear native T1 metrics may be supplementary, never mistaken for common-scale error gains

controls.NC1: Permute expression vectors among observed locations
controls.NC2: Permute observed coordinate assignment keeping expression vectors fixed; algebraically related to NC1, not independent evidence
controls.NC3: Permute image predictions across all locations; no expression inputs

metrics: fraction genes Pearson>0,.1,.2,.3; constant genes count as not passing; undefined correlations excluded only from correlation means/medians
aggregation: Mean over seeds, then equal geometry mean within patient/budget/regime/strategy; patient is biological unit; median across patients headline, individual results mandatory. No spot-level p values. Primary20% V1 random;10/40% support; FPS/V2 separate.

pass_criteria.meaningful_sparse: M2-M0 median gene Pearson>=.02 AND relative mean MSE reduction>=.02 AND MAE no worse
pass_criteria.core_support: At least2/3 evaluation patients meaningful at>=2/3 budgets; positive median Pearson and error gains at each budget; at least2/3 patients M2 Pearson40>10 and MSE40<10; distance assessed and all V2 reported
pass_criteria.harmonization: Cannot establish positive M2-M1 gain for affine invariant interpolation. Full PASS clause3 requires real gain/stability beyond numerical tolerance and cannot be satisfied by construction. Do not waive this condition after results.
pass_criteria.status: If core support but harmonization unidentifiable, overall MIXED_FRESH_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION with core and fusion conclusions separated; if heterogeneous sparse benefit, MIXED; if no meaningful benefit on at least2 patients at any budget, FAIL_FRESH_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION. Any integrity/leakage failure FAIL_TECHNICAL. Report patient/platform/image limitations explicitly.
pass_criteria.fusion_secondary: Report patient Pearson/MSE/MAE gains; success requires>=2/3 improve all3 metrics at>=2/3 budgets, <=25% patient/budget settings MSE harm>2%; not required for core support.
pass_criteria.distance: Compare patient error-bin curves, avoid extrapolation-horizon claim; lack of universal monotonicity disclosed, not tuned away.

C9C: Not preselected; optional only if readily available after C9B frozen

image_qualification.input_contract: Supplied unannotated Space Ranger tissue_hires_image.png, source-scaled coordinates, 112um square using lattice-calibrated mpp, nearest-integer width/top-left, LANCZOS to224 RGB; exact C0 ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1 transform and frozen weights.
image_qualification.limitation: Only15-25 native pixels per112um patch in supplied common images. Image-resolution domain shift weakens M0 and limits H&E comparisons; no superresolution or encoder change. PDF inspection finds first4patients similarly2000px whole-image views and larger crops for2patients only, without common fullres coordinate transforms. No PDF annotations used as model input. Molecular comparisons remain on original registered spots.
